_comment: Starting geometry-backed placeholder mounting data. AABBs are measured through production CreatureBody._fit and skin-correct RenderBounds at rest, not inferred from declared collision height. Seat/back anchors remain conservative anatomical estimates within those envelopes; no visual, animated-seat, mounted-network, or swimming acceptance is claimed. Re-measure and obtain blind rendered acceptance when each replacement lands.
_comment_coordinates: All offsets are creature-root-local metres at body_scale=1. surface_origin_offset_m adds to sea level to position the creature root. mount_offset is rider HIP anchor; production rider seat_drop_m=0.92 lowers trainer art from that anchor. All proposed trainer art origins exceed sea level by at least0.08m. Root architecture must scale offsets consistently for non-unit individuals.
_comment_tuning: Starting land multipliers multiply production human walk speed; these prioritize species swim identities without making every placeholder a superior land sprinter. Dismount distances exceed fitted half-width +0.4m human radius +0.25m clearance, rounded upward. Actual dismount placement must still query collision and water safety.
_comment_scale_2026_09_07: Every spatial measurement except saddle_scale was uniformly grown with its Water target body by tools/art_pipeline/creature_scale_ladder.py. The player-sized saddle remains unchanged; mount/saddle anchors, surface offset, dismount clearance, fitted AABB and collision radius all track the larger creature.
